Name: EnDetailer
Author: Enjuchan
Punchline: A DPS meter that shows what you are doing right now.
Description:
EnDetailer reads combat data from IINACT and shows the damage you are actually dealing right now, as a real-time value instead of the whole-fight average.

Unlike the usual encounter average, the value drops when you stop attacking - so it tells you whether your rotation is running, not how the fight went overall. The fight average is still one click away.

It keeps an encounter together across cutscenes, boss phases and downtime, shows a fight graph, details on hover and the last ten fights.

Requires IINACT.
